objective: Establish from Claude Code's documentation and the locked @anthropic-ai/claude-code package how the Workflow tool finds and runs workflows, including named workflows shipped by a plugin.
scope: Where named workflows are loaded from (built-in, .claude/workflows/, a plugin's workflows/ folder) and how a plugin workflow is named (plugin:name).
How a run is authorized (opt-in, permission prompt, PreToolUse hooks) and what `script`, `scriptPath`, `name` and `args` do.
Whether a workflow agent can be messaged or continued, and how agentType selects a plugin agent.
Read node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code in this repository (version 2.1.300) and the official docs; cite each fact with a source path or URL.
constraints: Read only; write nothing in the repository.

criteria.text: Each answer cites a doc URL or a path in the installed package; unknowns are named as Unknown.

result:
result: Plugin workflows load from the plugin's workflows/ folder (or manifest `workflows`), named <plugin>:<meta.name>; project .claude/workflows and ~/.claude/workflows win name clashes; built-ins fill the rest. The model may call Workflow only after explicit user opt-in (ultracode, direct request, a skill/command that calls it, a named saved workflow). Permission: deny/ask/allow rules Workflow(<name>) apply only to name runs; inline script and scriptPath always prompt ("Review dynamic workflow before running") unless auto/bypass mode or a PreToolUse hook returns allow. agentType resolves from the Agent registry, so plugin agents are plugin:agent. Messaging a workflow agent with SendMessage: Unknown; workflow agents return their final text or schema object and can be resumed only by resumeFromRunId replay.
